extDescription.message: AI-powered invoice detection: finds invoice emails in all your Thunderbird accounts, sorts them into monthly folders, and exports Romanian invoices to SAGA.

secBackendDesc.message: Choose how emails are classified. AI backends are more accurate; keywords work offline with zero setup.

backendClaudeDesc.message: Anthropic Claude. Fast and accurate. Reads PDF invoices for SAGA export.

backendOpenaiDesc.message: OpenAI models. Similar accuracy. Also works with OpenAI-compatible servers.

backendOllamaDesc.message: Fully local: no data leaves your computer. Requires Ollama.

backendKeywordsDesc.message: Pattern matching without AI. Catches obvious invoices. Zero setup, zero cost.

hintOllamaOrigins.message: Start Ollama with OLLAMA_ORIGINS="moz-extension://*". Do not use "*": it lets every website use your local Ollama.

hintPrivacy.message: Privacy: for classification, IncoBills sends the sender, subject, attachment names and the first 1000 characters of the body. For SAGA export with Claude/OpenAI, the full PDF attachment is sent (only with your consent below). A custom API URL asks for a host permission when you save.

hintThreshold.message: Lower = more aggressive (may catch non-invoices). Higher = more conservative (may miss some).

lblHybrid.message: Hybrid mode: use the AI only when keywords are not sure

hintHybrid.message: Emails with no invoice signal at all are skipped, and very clear invoices are accepted, without an AI call. This cuts API cost a lot.

hintFolderName.message: A subfolder for each month (e.g. 2026-10) is created automatically inside this folder.

hintFolderMode.message: Per account: each mailbox gets its own folder tree. Unified: all invoices go to one mailbox.

lblUnifiedAccount.message: Target account for the unified folder

lblLocalFallback.message: If the folder cannot be created on the server, use Local Folders

hintLocalFallback.message: Warning: mail moved to Local Folders is stored only on this computer, not on the mail server.

hintAction.message: Move: remove from the original folder. Copy: keep the original and add a copy to the invoice folder.

lblNotify.message: Show a desktop notification when an invoice is detected

lblNotifyOnly.message: Notify only: do not move or copy emails (overrides the options above)

hintContextMenu.message: Tip: right-click a message and choose "IncoBills: Mark as invoice" or "Not an invoice". IncoBills remembers the sender.

secAccountsDesc.message: When all accounts are checked, new accounts are monitored too.

warnNoAccounts.message: No account is checked: IncoBills will not process new mail.

secSagaDesc.message: Extract data from detected invoices and export SAGA XML files. e-Factura XML attachments are read exactly; PDF invoices need an AI backend.

noCompanies.message: No company yet. Add at least one company to turn on SAGA export.

errCompanyExists.message: A company with CIF $1 already exists.

errAnafNotFound.message: ANAF has no data for this CIF (check the CIF).

hintExportSubdir.message: XML files are saved in Downloads/<subfolder>/.

lblAutoExtract.message: Extract invoice data automatically from detected emails

lblCloudConsent.message: I agree to send full PDF invoices to the selected AI service (Claude, OpenAI or a remote Ollama)

hintCloudConsent.message: Invoices can contain personal data (GDPR). Without this consent, PDF invoices are extracted only with Ollama on this computer. e-Factura XML never leaves your computer.

lblAnafLookup.message: Complete partner data and VAT status from the public ANAF registry

hintAnafLookup.message: Only the CIF number and the invoice date are sent to webservicesp.anaf.ro.

lblSkipDomestic.message: Skip incoming invoices from Romanian suppliers

hintSkipDomestic.message: Turn on if you import these invoices into SAGA directly from SPV (e-Factura). IncoBills then handles foreign invoices only.

warnSagaNeedsAi.message: SAGA export is on, but the backend is "Keywords only". Only e-Factura XML attachments will be read. Select Claude, OpenAI or Ollama to read PDF invoices.

warnSagaConsent.message: PDF invoices will not be extracted until you agree to send them to the AI service (Export settings below).

hintQueue.message: Invoices read from a PDF by the AI must be reviewed before export. e-Factura invoices without errors are ready at once.

confirmClearQueue.message: Clear the queue? Open and failed items are removed. Exported invoices stay, for duplicate detection.

confirmRemoveQueueItem.message: Remove this item from the queue?

errNotExportable.message: Review this invoice first (errors, unknown direction or no company).

errQueueItemNoData.message: This item has no invoice data.

errRetryNoMessage.message: The original email was not found.

errRetryNoAttachments.message: The email has no PDF or e-Factura attachment.

errSagaNeedsAi.message: PDF invoice not extracted: select Claude, OpenAI or Ollama, then click Retry.

errSagaNoConsent.message: PDF invoice not extracted: agree to send PDFs to the AI service in SAGA settings, then click Retry.

errPdfNoText.message: The PDF has no text layer (scanned image). Use Claude or OpenAI for this invoice.

reviewApproved.message: Invoice marked as reviewed. It is ready for export.

reviewHasErrors.message: Fix the errors above before you mark the invoice as reviewed.

valDirectionUnknown.message: Direction is unknown: none of your companies matches the supplier or client CIF. Choose the direction and company.

valIntraGroup.message: Supplier and client are both your companies.

valCifChecksum.message: Romanian CIF $1 fails the check digit. The AI may have misread it.

valLineVat.message: Line $1: VAT should be $2, but it is $3.

valSumMismatch.message: Sum of line values ($1) does not match the total without VAT ($2).

valVatSumMismatch.message: Sum of line VAT ($1) does not match the VAT total ($2).

valTotalMismatch.message: Total without VAT + VAT ($1) does not match the total with VAT ($2).

valReverseChargeWithVat.message: Reverse charge is set, but the invoice has VAT.

valPartnerInactive.message: ANAF lists partner $1 as inactive. VAT deduction may not be allowed.

valCompanyMissing.message: Choose which of your companies this invoice belongs to.

secRulesDesc.message: Created with the right-click menu. A rule decides without keywords or AI.

secScanDesc.message: Find invoices that arrived before you installed IncoBills.

hintScan.message: Sent, Drafts, Trash, Junk, Templates and the invoice folder are skipped. Emails processed before are skipped too. The scan continues if you close this page.

confirmResetProcessed.message: Forget which emails were processed? The next scan checks them again (this can cost API calls).

resetProcessedDone.message: Done. The next scan checks all emails again.

scanNothing.message: Nothing to scan: all $1 email(s) in this range were processed before.

scanConfirmLocal.message: Scan $1 new email(s) (of $2 in range) with keywords?

scanConfirmAi.message:
Scan $1 new email(s) (of $2 in range) with $3?

Up to about $4 input tokens.$5

scanHybridNote.message: Hybrid mode skips the AI for clear cases, so the real number is usually much lower.

confirmClearHistory.message: Clear the classification history? This cannot be undone.

bannerBackendFailing.message: The $1 backend is failing, so IncoBills uses keywords. Last error: $2

warnPermissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted for $1: calls to this custom URL will fail.

errOllamaUnreachable.message: Cannot reach Ollama at $1. Make sure it runs and was started with OLLAMA_ORIGINS="moz-extension://*". Detail: $2

errOllamaForbidden.message: Ollama refused the request (403). Restart Ollama with OLLAMA_ORIGINS="moz-extension://*".

errCannotCreateFolder.message: Cannot create the "$1" folder. Create it manually, or allow the Local Folders fallback in settings.

notifBackendFailingBody.message: $1 calls fail, so keywords are used instead. Check Settings. Error: $2

notifMarkedInvoice.message: $1 message(s) marked as invoice. The sender is remembered.

notifMarkedNotInvoice.message: $1 message(s) marked as not an invoice. The sender is remembered.

popupToggleTitle.message: Turn invoice detection on or off

valDirectionMismatch.message: Company $1 is not the $2 on this invoice. Check the direction, the company and the CIFs.

errDownloadInterrupted.message: The download was interrupted. Export the invoice again.
